meta.title: Operations and stock · Clafina
meta.description: Know what you hold, where and what it is worth. Reorder levels, blind counts on a phone, transfers in transit and bills matched to what arrived.

hero.title: Know what you hold, where, and what to order next.
hero.lede: One movement ledger for every place, with reorder levels, counts on a phone and purchases matched to what really arrived.

pains.pain: You find out you have run out when a customer asks.
pains.fix: Reorder levels set a minimum, a safety level, a reorder point and a quantity for each item in each place. Order what needs it turns the shortfall into orders.

pains.pain: Counts never agree with the books.
pains.fix: Count sheets can be blind, so the counter sees what was expected only after saving. Count on a phone, shelf by shelf.
Transfers record what left, what is in transit and what arrived. Adjustments above a value you set go through approval.

pains.pain: Suppliers bill for what never arrived.
pains.fix: Goods received are checked against the order, and the bill against both. A bill that doesn't match is held before it is paid.

pains.pain: Short-dated stock is found too late.
pains.fix: Batches carry their expiry, and stock classes with cycle counts keep attention on the items that matter most.

pains.pain: Deliveries leave with no proof they arrived.
pains.fix: Waybills take stock out when they leave, are followed on the road and are signed for or disputed at the door.

story.before: Arewa sells grain, oil and provisions to shops across the city from a warehouse and a depot. Reorders were the storekeeper's guess. The monthly count took a weekend and never matched, and bills were paid on the supplier's word.
story.after: Now each item has a level at each place, and the reorder list builds the orders. The storekeeper counts on a phone without seeing what is expected. Goods received are checked against the order, and a bill for more than arrived waits.

modules.why: One movement ledger, reorder levels, counts, batches and transfers between places.
Requisitions, quotes compared, goods received and bills matched before payment.
Waybills that move stock when they leave and are signed for on delivery.
Counts and goods received on a phone.
Machines and vehicles kept maintained, with parts taken from stock.
Delivery notes and supplier bills read into drafts to check.

plan.why: Stock and sales come with every plan. Business adds approval policies for transfers, adjustments and purchases, the API for your own tools and the audit trail.

faq.a: By moving average or FIFO, with landed costs, and the stock account always equals the stock value.

faq.q: Can we see what we held on a past date?
faq.a: Yes. The movement ledger only adds, never overwrites, so you can see the position on any past date.

faq.q: Can stock change without a document?
faq.a: You choose. One setting means stock moves only through documents, and adjustment requests above a value go through approval.

faq.q: Can we count on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. Count on a phone with a blind count, and receive goods on it as they arrive.

cta.title: Count it once, and trust it.
cta.body: Start with your items and places, and set reorder levels as you go.
